# fanout — per-item fan-out across a list of incidents
# Boots the fanout scenario, runs one drain. The list step returns three
# incidents; the detail step fans out over them with merge: flatten so the
# producer body is the concatenation of three per-incident JSON lists.
# Events come out in declared incident order (alpha, beta, gamma), and
# the trace records every per-item exchange (list + 3 details = 4 lines).
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml fanout
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
